verdict.rationale: Jitsu's own connector syncs pull data into the warehouse from third-party sources using Airbyte-compatible connectors, with 300+ sources including Google Analytics and Stripe. It also ingests feeds from Segment via webhook, so customer data is not limited to your own instrumented apps. A community user confirms that most major ad sources are available but reports a higher bar to implementation than Segment, which is a caveat rather than a contradiction. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party docs on connector configuration, scheduling and incremental sync behavior, plus independent hands-on corroboration of connector reliability.

support.subject: As a data engineer, I can pull customer data in from third-party cloud apps and feeds — not just my own instrumented apps

citations.quote: Connector syncs — pull data *into* your warehouse from third-party sources (Airbyte-compatible connectors).
offering seamless connections to over 300+ data sources including giants like Google Analytics, Stripe, and Postgres.
